1.t: By the Night as it conceals (the light);

2.t: By the Day as it appears in glory;

3.t: By (the mystery of) the creation of male and female;-

4.t: Verily, (the ends) ye strive for are diverse.

5.t: So he who gives (in charity) and fears (Allah),

6.t: And (in all sincerity) testifies to the best,-

7.t: We will indeed make smooth for him the path to Bliss.

8.t: But he who is a greedy miser and thinks himself self-sufficient,

9.t: And gives the lie to the best,-

10.t: We will indeed make smooth for him the path to Misery;

11.t: Nor will his wealth profit him when he falls headlong (into the Pit).

12.t: Verily We take upon Ourselves to guide,

13.t: And verily unto Us (belong) the End and the Beginning.

14.t: Therefore do I warn you of a Fire blazing fiercely;

15.t: None shall reach it but those most unfortunate ones

16.t: Who give the lie to Truth and turn their backs.

17.t: But those most devoted to Allah shall be removed far from it,-

18.t: Those who spend their wealth for increase in self-purification,

19.t: And have in their minds no favour from anyone for which a reward is expected in return,

20.t: But only the desire to seek for the Countenance of their Lord Most High;

21.t: And soon will they attain (complete) satisfaction.
